svg.title: Match the Solution to the Shape of the Work
svg.desc: Four business needs matched to a solution: a one-off draft to Copilot, a research report to the Researcher agent, a goal across systems and days to a custom agent, and a fixed rule-based file move to scripted automation.
svg.text: Match the Solution to the Shape of the Work
One prompted task needs Copilot; a goal across steps, systems or days needs an agent.
Plans steps, keeps state, uses tools
